adjustment.name: US ESI single premium added to tax wedge (article method)

benchmark.name: US single AW100 wedge with ESI no longer lowest (within Nordic band)
benchmark.note: Article states US pays 'just as much, if not more' at the average wage; replication finds US (37.95) is above Denmark (35.76) and Norway (36.39) but below the Nordic mean (38.94). The figure's defensible claim is that the US is no longer the lowest-tax country.
